utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case number IT-95-16-T, the Prosecutor versus Zoran Kupreskic, Mirjan Kupreskic, Vlatko Kupreskic, Drago Josipovic, Dragan Papic and Vladimir Santic also know as Vlado.

utterances.speaker: MR. MOSKOWITZ
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. May I proceed?

utterances.speaker: MR. MOSKOWITZ
utterances.text: May I inquire first if we are in closed session? I think we'll need to be in closed session for the first series of questions. (Closed session)

utterances.speaker: MR. MOSKOWITZ
